before.title: VQ35DE Oil Consumption
before.description: The VQ35DE engine in the G35 is known to consume excessive oil, sometimes burning 1 quart every 1,000-2,000 miles. This is typically caused by worn valve stem seals and piston rings that allow oil to enter the combustion chamber.
before.solution: Replace valve stem seals and inspect piston rings. In severe cases, a short block replacement may be necessary. Use manufacturer-recommended 5W-30 oil and monitor consumption between changes.
symptoms: Blue/white smoke from exhaust on startup
Low oil level warnings between changes

before.title: Steering Wheel Lock Malfunction
before.description: The electronic steering wheel lock mechanism can malfunction, preventing the car from starting or causing intermittent no-start conditions. The steering lock actuator motor fails internally, triggering a security fault.
before.solution: Replace the steering lock actuator or have the dealer reprogram the BCM. Some owners bypass the lock mechanism entirely, though this may affect resale value. A TSB was issued for certain model years.
symptoms: Car will not start with key in ignition

before.title: Power Window Regulator Failure
before.description: The power window regulators in the G35 are prone to failure, causing windows to fall into the door or operate slowly. The plastic guide clips and cable mechanism wear out, especially in hot climates.
before.solution: Replace the window regulator assembly. Aftermarket regulators are available at lower cost than OEM. The repair involves removing the door panel and disconnecting the window motor.
